about: The reviewed belongs_on rules for catalog/materials/materials.json (docs/studio/CONTRACTS.md section 3). Applied by tools/materials/belongs_on.mjs (--write), held by the viewer kit's test `every_material_row_has_a_reviewed_belongs_on`. A row's decision is its longest matching `ids` key (an exact id, or a prefix ending in `.`), else its `subcategories` entry (category/subcategory). A decision is a class id from catalog/assets/assets.json (written as belongs_on), `generic: <why>` (deliberately none: it goes on anything) or `waits <class>: <why>` (made for an asset class that isn't in assets.json yet: nothing is written until the class is added, then rerun the script). Every subcategory has an entry, so a new row is always decided.
